lead.topic: Aramm (2017): a borewell rescue told from inside an enquiry room
lead.insight: Aramm opens with Collector Madhivadhani facing a senior official and telling him what happened a week ago. Because we meet her on trial first, every call she makes at the borewell plays as evidence. The frame turns a rescue film into a courtroom, and the clock feels twice as loud.
lead.why_now: Nayanthara's birthday is today (18 Nov, brief); Aramm's title and first look were revealed on her birthday in 2016, exactly 10 years ago (Wikipedia). Afternoon slot: words TONIGHT / AFTER WORK.
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aramm (dir. N. Gopi Nainar; Nayanthara as Collector Madhivadhani; story begins with her telling a higher official what happened a week ago in Kattoor; title and first look revealed 18 Nov 2016)
lead.technique: Frame story (a story told inside another story)
lead.pictures_note: Official trailer (Think Music India, hWsn_1cs6Dc) and teaser (IDW_vJIeGzA), checked by eye on 18 Nov: trailer maxresdefault is the card (Nayanthara right; crop cuts the title, TRAILER word and corner mark), maxres1 Nayanthara bent over a radio set, maxres2 villagers running with a child; teaser maxres3 police and army at the barricade. No enquiry-room frame: the timeline and technique screens carry the room as graphics.
lead.spoiler_note: Only the opening frame and the set-up; nothing about how the rescue or the enquiry ends.

worth_it.learn: Aramm is built as a frame story: the enquiry room makes every rescue decision feel like evidence.
worth_it.stop: A rescue film that starts with the hero already on trial.
worth_it.why_now: Nayanthara's birthday today; Aramm's first look came on this day in 2016.
worth_it.send_to: The Nayanthara fan who calls Aramm her best film.
worth_it.best_angle: Yes: the structure is why a simple rescue feels like a thriller.

screens.voice: அறம். இந்த படம் ஒரு விசாரணை அறையில ஆரம்பிக்குது. ஏன்?
screens.voice_tg: Aram. Indha padam oru visaaranai araiyila aarambikkudhu. Yen?

screens.voice: கலெக்டர் மதிவதனி ஒரு அதிகாரி முன்னாடி உட்கார்ந்திருக்காங்க. அவங்க சொல்ற கதை, ஒரு வாரம் முன்னாடி நடந்தது. ஒரு ஆழ்துளை கிணறு. ஒரு சின்ன பொண்ணு.
screens.voice_tg: Collector Madhivadhani oru adhigaari munnaadi utkaarndhirukkaanga. Avanga solra kadhai, oru vaaram munnaadi nadandhadhu. Oru aazhthulai kinaru. Oru chinna ponnu.

screens.name: FRAME STORY
screens.voice: இந்த டெக்னிக் பேரு, ஃப்ரேம் ஸ்டோரி. ஒரு கதைக்குள்ள, இன்னொரு கதை.
screens.voice_tg: Indha technique peru, frame story. Oru kadhaikkulla, innoru kadhai.

screens.heading: HOW THE FRAME WORKS
screens.voice: முதல்ல விசாரணை. அப்புறம் கிணறு. அவங்க எடுக்கிற ஒவ்வொரு முடிவும், அந்த அறையில கேள்வியா நிக்குது.
screens.voice_tg: Mudhalla visaaranai. Appuram kinaru. Avanga edukkira ovvoru mudivum, andha araiyila kelviyaa nikkudhu.

screens.heading: WHAT THE FRAME ADDS
screens.label: PRESSURE
screens.voice: அதனால, இது வெறும் மீட்பு கதை இல்ல. ஒரு விசாரணை. ஒவ்வொரு நிமிஷமும் நமக்கு பதட்டம்.
screens.voice_tg: Adhanaala, idhu verum meetpu kadhai illa. Oru visaaranai. Ovvoru nimishamum namakku padhattam.

screens.voice: அப்போ உண்மையில விசாரணை யாருக்கு? அவங்களுக்கா, இல்ல சிஸ்டத்துக்கா? இன்னிக்கு நயன்தாரா பிறந்தநாள். அறம் பாருங்க.
screens.voice_tg: Appo unmaiyila visaaranai yaarukku? Avangalukkaa, illa system-ukkaa? Innikku Nayanthara pirandhanaal. Aram paarunga.

screens.voice: இது தான் ஃப்ரேம் ஸ்டோரி. உங்க பதில் என்ன? கமெண்ட்ல சொல்லுங்க.
screens.voice_tg: Idhu thaan frame story. Unga badhil enna? Comment-la sollunga.

caption: Aramm starts in an enquiry room, not at the borewell.

The technique is called a frame story: a story told inside another story. Because we meet Collector Madhivadhani already facing questions, every choice she makes at the borewell feels like evidence. A rescue film becomes a trial. No spoilers here.
Who was really on trial?
Happy birthday, Nayanthara. Aramm's first look came out on her birthday in 2016.
கதைக்குள்ள ஒரு கதை.
